description: This file defines a custom layout manager class 'VerticalFlowLayout' in Java, which arranges components vertically in a container with various alignment options. It includes configuration methods, layout calculations, and serialization support.

classes.name: VerticalFlowLayout
classes.description: A custom layout manager in Java for arranging components vertically with various alignment options and serialization support.

methods.name: setMaximizeOtherDimension
methods.description: Sets a flag to maximize the other dimension of components during layout.

methods.name: isMaximizeOtherDimension
methods.description: Returns whether the layout is set to maximize the other dimension.

methods.name: getAlignment
methods.description: Returns the current alignment setting for layout of the components.

methods.name: setAlignment
methods.description: Sets the alignment for laying out components (top, center, bottom, leading, trailing).

methods.name: getHgap
methods.description: Returns the horizontal gap between components.

methods.name: setHgap
methods.description: Sets the horizontal gap between components.

methods.name: getVgap
methods.description: Returns the vertical gap between components.

methods.name: setVgap
methods.description: Sets the vertical gap between components.

methods.name: addLayoutComponent
methods.description: Method required by LayoutManager interface; not used in this class.

methods.name: removeLayoutComponent
methods.description: Method required by LayoutManager interface; not used in this class.

methods.name: preferredLayoutSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the preferred layout size based on visible components.

methods.name: minimumLayoutSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the minimum layout size needed to display visible components.

methods.name: moveComponents
methods.description: Aligns components within a row based on the specified alignment setting.

methods.name: layoutContainer
methods.description: Performs the actual layout of components within the container, arranging them vertically with specified gaps and alignments.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the layout manager with its current configuration.
